note: Starter Library = the owner's three characters plus assets the owner approved for everyone. 2026-09-29: added the Blender-made Tidewater kit (buildings, nature, props, boats, terrain). The old 4,000+ model catalog and outside asset host stay deleted.

sources.human: Owner's own Meshy AI model (Downloads/meshy ai assets glbs/Meshy_AI_Meshy_Merged_Animations (2).glb). Rigged, 24 joints, Walking and Running clips. Textures shrunk to 1024 px. It looks like a real person, so confirm the likeness may be shown publicly.
